resources.string: ConnectDesk lets YOU (or a parent/guardian who set this up with you) view device status, files and notifications from a web dashboard. A persistent notification appears whenever this app is connected, and you can disconnect anytime from this screen. This app does not hide, record keystrokes, or access your camera or microphone.

To show phone notifications on the dashboard, Android requires Notification access. Content is masked on this phone before it leaves (OTPs/passwords are never synced). You can turn this off anytime in Settings.
ConnectDesk screen session active — tap Stop to end anytime
Your dashboard is asking to view this screen. Tap to review and allow or deny — nothing is captured without your permission.
Your dashboard asked for a photo. Tap to open the camera for one shot — nothing is saved on the phone.
Use the same username and password as the web dashboard. A new account is created automatically on first sign-in.
Waiting for approval on the dashboard…
Access was turned off from your dashboard. This phone is still signed in — turn it back on from the dashboard and it reconnects by itself.
This phone was removed from your ConnectDesk account, so it has been signed out. Sign in again to reconnect.
Still signed in — reconnecting to the dashboard (%1$s)
no connection to the ConnectDesk server

Chat sync sends only the message previews Android already shows on your lock screen (sender + message) from WhatsApp, Instagram, Snapchat and similar apps. Android does not let any app read a real chat database, and ConnectDesk does not try to. You need to grant Notification access first, and you can turn this off here at any time.

Clipboard sync only works while this screen is open — Android blocks backgrounded apps from reading the clipboard, and ConnectDesk does not attempt to work around that. Passwords, OTPs and card numbers are dropped on this phone before anything is sent.
Grant Usage access (for app list and screen time)

Android does not let any app record the other person on a call, so this records only your own microphone. It starts by itself after the other side picks up, shows a permanent notification the whole time, and the file is deleted from this phone as soon as it reaches the dashboard. You can stop any recording from that notification.
Only the microphone on this phone is being recorded. Tap Stop to end it.
Waiting for a call. Recording covers your microphone only.
Your camera is streaming to the dashboard. Tap Stop to turn it off.

Your camera streams to your dashboard while this is on. A permanent notification stays visible the whole time and you can stop it from there or from this screen. ConnectDesk never turns the camera on by itself — only you can, from here.
Your microphone is streaming to the dashboard. Tap Stop to turn it off.

Your microphone streams to your dashboard while this is on. A permanent notification stays visible the whole time and you can stop it from there or from this screen. Nothing is saved on the phone, and ConnectDesk never turns the microphone on by itself — only you can, from here.
Dashboard wants to view your camera
Tap to open ConnectDesk and allow or refuse. Nothing is recorded until you do.
Dashboard wants to listen to your mic
Tap to open ConnectDesk and allow or refuse. Nothing is recorded until you do.
ConnectDesk is taking a photo (back camera)
ConnectDesk is taking a photo (front camera)
The dashboard asked for this photo and you already allowed camera access for ConnectDesk.
Setup complete — every permission is granted. ConnectDesk will not ask again; anything the dashboard triggers will only show a notification on the phone.
The dashboard is now mirroring this screen. Use the notification below to stop it.
